# hpe_morpheus_network_type (Data Source)



## Example Usage

### Look up by ID

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_network_type" "example" {
  id = 99
}
```

### Look up by Name

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_network_type" "example" {
  name = "Host Network"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the network type
- `name` (String) The name of the network type

### Read-Only

- `category` (String) The category of the network type
- `code` (String) The code of the network type
- `creatable` (Boolean) Whether this network type can be created
- `description` (String) The description of the network type
